name: Popover
description: Radix Popover. Non-modal by default: the page stays interactive and scrollable. Positioned automatically with collision detection.
intent: Contextual content anchored to a trigger, without blocking the page.

authority.note: src/ is authoritative. If this contract disagrees with the source, implement from the source and report the drift.

parts.name: PopoverTrigger
parts.note: Use asChild to wrap your own control

props.name: align
props.hint: Accepted by this component and passed to the underlying primitive. Named in the component signature, so it is part of this surface.

props.name: sideOffset
props.hint: Accepted by this component and passed to the underlying primitive. Named in the component signature, so it is part of this surface.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

keyboard: Escape — close and return focus to trigger
requiredAttributes: An accessible name on the trigger
accessibility.focusManagement: Focus moves into the content on open and returns to the trigger on close.
notes: Non-modal: the rest of the page stays interactive. That is the difference from ui:dialog.
Content is portalled, so overflow-hidden ancestors do not clip it.

forbiddenUsage: Nesting a modal dialog inside a popover
agentRules: Never hide critical information in a popover.
Use ui:dropdown-menu for action lists, not this.
